#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <set>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

void addMissing(string& sb, int a) {
    bool used[26] = {false};
    int start = max(0, (int)sb.size() - a);
    for (int i = start; i < (int)sb.size(); i++) {
        used[sb[i] - 'a'] = true;
    }
    int need = a;
    for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z' && need > 0; c++) {
        if (!used[c - 'a']) {
            sb.push_back(c);
            need--;
        }
    }
}

void addLast(string& sb, int b) {
    char ch = sb.back();
    for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) {
        sb.push_back(ch);
    }
}

void solve() {
    int a, b, l, r;
    cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;

    string fin;
    for (int i = 0; i < a; i++) {
        fin.push_back('a' + i);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) {
        fin.push_back('a' + a - 1);
    }

    int x = l % (a + b);
    if (x == 0) x = a + b;
    if (x > 1) {
        fin.erase(0, x - 1);
    }

    addMissing(fin, a);
    addLast(fin, b);
    addMissing(fin, a);
    addLast(fin, b);

    set<char> distinct;
    int limit = min(r - l + 1, (int)fin.size());
    for (int i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
        distinct.insert(fin[i]);
    }
    cout << distinct.size() << endl;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    solve();
    return 0;
}
